description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Nanaimo is a chain hotel on Rosehill Street in Nanaimo, BC, part of the global Wyndham Hotels & Resorts portfolio. Nanaimo serves as a primary arrival and departure point for cyclists taking BC Ferries to and from the Lower Mainland, making a centrally located hotel here a practical overnight stop. No cycling-specific services or infrastructure could be confirmed from the available website content.
